HERO.TITLE: Draya
HERO.TAGLINE_SUB: Designed for Egyptian Private Tutors & Centers
HERO.DESCRIPTION: Generate exams with AI, detect student knowledge gaps, and share approved parent reports effortlessly.

BENEFITS.HEADING: An Integrated Platform for Egyptian Teachers
BENEFITS.SUBTITLE: Designed with leading educators to simplify tutoring operations and center management.
BENEFITS.B1_DESC: Not generic AI — it analyzes your videos and PDFs to generate accurate questions directly from your material.
BENEFITS.B2_DESC: Every AI-generated exam and report must be approved by you before being sent to students or parents.
BENEFITS.B3_DESC: Weakness maps show exact student-level difficulties with actionable data.
BENEFITS.B4_DESC: An RTL-first Arabic interface built from the ground up for Egyptian educators and centers.
BENEFITS.B5_DESC: From sign-in to your first published lecture in two minutes without technical training.
BENEFITS.B6_DESC: Draya students improve their grades by an average of 31% within the first 3 months.

FEATURES.HEADING: Complete Control and Transparency
FEATURES.F1_DESC: Create packages, courses, and lectures with video, homework, and exams without switching tools.
FEATURES.F1_I1: Simple steps to create packages and courses
FEATURES.F1_I2: Upload video and PDF from the same screen
FEATURES.F1_I3: Publish immediately or save as draft
FEATURES.F2_DESC: Package → Course → Lecture. Track progress, review assignments, and revisit weaknesses with one click.
FEATURES.F2_I3: Grades, weakness maps, and review links
FEATURES.F3_TITLE: AI as an Assistant, Not a Replacement
FEATURES.F3_DESC: Generates questions from lecture content and crafts reports — but you approve before delivery.
FEATURES.F3_I1: Generate 20 questions in 30 seconds from video or PDF
FEATURES.F3_I3: All AI content is clearly labeled — never mixed with teacher content

PRICING.HEADING: Start Risk-Free — Pay Only When You Succeed
PRICING.SUBTITLE: We eliminated forced monthly subscriptions. On Draya, your entire platform is free to use, and you only share a modest percentage on actual sales.

PILLARS.ZERO_FEES_DESC: No upfront package costs or mandatory subscriptions. Every core feature is ready right after registration.
PILLARS.PERCENT_DESC: We only succeed when you do. When a student enrolls, a simple 10% platform fee applies and the rest goes directly to your wallet.
PILLARS.AI_DESC: Generate interactive exams and parental performance reports with AI for free, with flexible pay-as-you-go top-ups.

COMPARISON.TRADITIONAL_1: Forced monthly fees (499 - 2000 EGP) paid in advance
COMPARISON.TRADITIONAL_2: Feature lockouts and student limits unless you upgrade
COMPARISON.TRADITIONAL_3: Paying subscriptions even during vacations and off-season
COMPARISON.DRAYA_1: 0 EGP subscription fee, zero recurring liabilities
COMPARISON.DRAYA_2: Unlimited students, classrooms, and video lectures for everyone
COMPARISON.DRAYA_3: Instant wallet payouts to your bank account

STUDENT_NOTE.TITLE: What about Students & Parents?
STUDENT_NOTE.DESC: Student accounts are 100% free with zero platform fees. Students only pay the exact price of the classroom or course chosen via direct card payment with full access to lectures and exams.

TESTIMONIALS.HEADING: Trusted by Hundreds of Teachers
TESTIMONIALS.T1_QUOTE: Draya saved me hours in preparing exams. The best part is the AI suggests but I approve — crucial for credibility with parents.
TESTIMONIALS.T2_QUOTE: Students track their own progress without me having to manually edit sheets. Reports reach parents faster and clearer.
TESTIMONIALS.T3_QUOTE: Parent reports used to take an entire day. Now they take minutes to review and approve. A real game changer.

FAQ.HEADING: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.Q1: Can I try Draya for free?
FAQ.A1: Yes, start with our Free Basic plan without a credit card. It supports up to 50 students and 2 courses.
FAQ.Q2: Is Draya fully available in Arabic?
FAQ.A2: Yes, completely. The platform is designed RTL-first for Egyptian teachers and students.
FAQ.Q3: How does AI work in Draya?
FAQ.A3: The AI analyzes lecture videos or PDFs and generates questions & reports for teacher approval before sending.
FAQ.Q4: Does the platform suit large centers?
FAQ.A4: Yes, our Enterprise plan is tailored for large centers with white-labeling, API integrations, and dedicated support.
FAQ.A5: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and Egyptian mobile wallets (Vodafone Cash, Orange Cash).
